The '''South Depot''' was a location on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]]. During the construction of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Palmo armory]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> around [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">{{AndorDate|205}}</ref> the [[Ghorman Front]] learned that nightly cargo-carrier shipments for the building of the armory originated from the South Depot.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />
